description:
Others' Inner Hearts Ahn Yu-min, who has a special ability to listen to music in people's heart, has a one-night stay with Shin Yi-hyuk, who is the only one who can't hear his heart at the pub he often goes to. Upon learning of Lee Hyuk's unique sexual orientation, Yu-min gradually becomes addicted to him before hiding his embarrassment, and he can't escape...

**Original Webtoon:**  
[MComics](https://www.mcomics.co.kr/contents?idx=6591), [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/505016237), [Bomtoon](https://bomtoon.com/comic/ep_list/Pnk_M), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/pinkmolly), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.nhn?productNo=4483665), [BookCube](https://www.bookcube.com/toon/detail.asp?webtoon_num=190179), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_pink_wz)
